summary: Westin Acquisition Corp, a Cayman blank-check company, filed an 8-K on July 22, 2026, announcing a definitive Business Combination Agreement with First Choice Healthcare Solutions, a Delaware healthcare services company, and its wholly owned subsidiary, First Choice Acquisition Corp. Westin will domesticate from the Cayman Islands to Nevada, becoming Wellgevity 360, Inc., then merge Merger Sub into First Choice, with First Choice surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. The filing provides initial deal structure but no financial terms, pricing, or premium. Watch for shareholder vote, redemptions, and regulatory approvals; risk-arb hinges on deal valuation and closing timeline.
